title: Active Record Associations
intro: Active Record associations are a mandatory topic in every Rails interview, and the questions range from basic (what's the difference between belongs_to and has_many) to design-level (when to use has_many :through vs has_and_belongs_to_many, and why through is almost always right). This page covers the full association toolkit: belongs_to (required by default in Rails 5+), has_many, has_one, has_many :through (and why it's always preferable to HABTM — you can always add columns to the join table later), polymorphic associations with as: and source_type:, self-referential associations, and the dependent: options (:destroy vs :nullify vs :restrict_with_error). The inverse_of option appears in scenario questions about validation failures with unsaved associations.
